name: 知っている語を横へ仕分けるカード
prompt: Redesign the existing Lighthouse Japanese flashcard screen as a clean portrait mobile screen matching the native 390×724 preview. Preserve its exact layout hierarchy, stacked swipe-card proportions, visible Japanese wording, progress count, undo affordance, and bottom helper text. Use the native preview as the authority for Japanese copy and structure. Use the original Quizlet screenshot only for the stacked-card interaction and count placement; do not copy its Mobbin watermark, cropped English content, or mint color treatment. Use the attached user example only for palette preference: pure white surfaces, neutral gray inactive states and outlines, and a clear solid green active state. Do not copy its icons, numbers, or geometry. Remove all pale mint, cyan, orange, and other pastel tint fills or strokes. Canvas, cards, and badges with no active state are white; card borders are light neutral gray (#E5E7EB). Use near-black primary type and medium neutral gray secondary text. Keep 知っている as a high-contrast forest-green label and 痛み as the centered vocabulary word. Show the known count 1 as a flat forest-green pill (#1F6444) with a white numeral; show count 0 in a white neutral-outline pill with gray numeral. Keep the front and rear cards white with neutral outlines. Use a small flat forest-green play triangle and a neutral gray undo icon. Preserve the exact bottom line: 左へ動かすと「学習中」に戻ります. Use Meiryo-compatible Japanese typography, clear spacing, accessible contrast, and restrained native UI. Flat colors only: no gradients, shadows, glows, translucent color overlays, textured fills, or tinted page backgrounds. Do not add or translate any copy beyond what is visible in the native preview.
reviewNotes: Palette is white/neutral with solid green active state. Needs one correction for the extra status bar and native offscreen front-card crop.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
